description: This module allows the creation, deletion, and modification of Keycloak authentication flows using the Keycloak REST API.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: The name of the authentication flow.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_keycloak_url
parameters.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: authenticationExecutions
parameters.description: The desired execution configuration for the flow. Executions at root level.

parameters.name: authenticationConfig
parameters.description: The configuration for the execution.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Options for the execution config.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: The providerId of the execution.

parameters.name: requirement
parameters.description: The requirement status of the execution or sub-flow. Choices: "REQUIRED" "ALTERNATIVE" "DISABLED" "CONDITIONAL"

parameters.name: subFlow
parameters.description: The name of the sub-flow.

parameters.name: subFlowType
parameters.description: The type of the sub-flow. Choices: "basic-flow" ← (default) "form-flow"

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A human-readable description of the flow.

parameters.name: force_temporary_swap_flow_deletion
parameters.description: If true, any pre-existing temporary swap flow (identified by the original alias plus temporary_swap_flow_suffix) is deleted before the Safe Swap procedure begins. Set this to false to cause the module to fail instead of silently removing a pre-existing temporary flow, for example to avoid accidental data loss after an interrupted run. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the realm in which the authentication flow resides.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the authentication flow should exist or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: temporary_swap_flow_suffix
parameters.description: The suffix appended to the alias of the temporary flow created during a Safe Swap update. The temporary flow exists only for the duration of the swap procedure and is renamed to the original alias once all bindings have been successfully transferred. Default: "_tmp_for_swap"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create or modify the 'My Login Flow'.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication_v2:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    alias: My Login Flow
    authenticationExecutions:
      - providerId: idp-review-profile
        requirement: REQUIRED
        authenticationConfig:
          alias: My Login Flow - review profile config
          config:
            update.profile.on.first.login: "missing"
      - subFlow: My Login Flow - User creation or linking
        requirement: REQUIRED
        authenticationExecutions:
          - providerId: idp-create-user-if-unique
            requirement: ALTERNATIVE
            authenticationConfig:
              alias: My Login Flow - create unique user config
              config:
                require.password.update.after.registration: "true"
          - providerId: auth-cookie
            requirement: REQUIRED
          - subFlow: My Login Flow - Handle Existing Account
            requirement: ALTERNATIVE
            authenticationExecutions:
              - providerId: idp-confirm-link
                requirement: REQUIRED
      - providerId: auth-cookie
        requirement: DISABLED
    state: present

- name: Remove an authentication flow.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication_v2:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    alias: My Login Flow
    state: absent

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the authentication flow after module execution.
